title: Spicy Tagine Chicken Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional tacos, featuring chicken cooked in a tagine-inspired sauce served with crispy tacos and fresh toppings.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the cumin, chili powder, and cayenne pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the oats and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lime juice and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Shred the chicken with two forks and serve in tacos with your favorite toppings.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
